description.narrative: Awareness campaigns on the importance of education for students in general and girls in particular; providing students with school bags, school uniforms, hygiene kits and dignity kits for female students; strengthening psychosocial support and child protection; facilitating referral services for children; building the capacity of education volunteers in effective teaching methods; providing teachers with educational tools; providing teaching aids kits for classrooms, first aid kits, hygiene kits and sports development supplies in targeted schools; providing tables and chairs; and repainting classrooms in targeted schools.
Strengthen the educational process and protection for children affected by armed conflict in Yemen, contributing to enhancing their ability to learn and grow in a safe and effective environment.
Strengthening the educational process and protection for children affected by armed conflict in the targeted areas of Yemen (Lahij Governorate, Al-Hawtah and Tuban districts).
Disbursement for "Strengthening the Educational Process" in Yemen, implemented by Modern Social Foundation
